landing.heroTitle: Governing Civic Action to Turn Community Needs into Verifiable Impact
landing.heroSubtitle: NEXUS DZ provides the digital infrastructure connecting accredited associations, field volunteers, and impact verifiers in Constantine across a complete lifecycle: from need identification to audited proof.
landing.pillarsSubtitle: Engineered for institutional transparency, role isolation, and measurable outcomes
landing.pillar1Desc: Directory and compliance management for local associations across Constantine's communes.
landing.pillar2Desc: Structured breakdown of community programs into actionable volunteer assignments.
landing.pillar3Desc: Structured collection of field documentation stored in access-controlled Supabase buckets.
landing.pillar4Desc: Independent verification workflows before volunteer hours and beneficiary metrics are certified.

about.title: About NEXUS DZ
about.subtitle: A modern software foundation advancing civic-tech and volunteer management in Algeria, starting in Constantine.
about.missionBody: NEXUS DZ bridges the gap between grassroots community action and measurable institutional reporting by providing a verifiable system of record for associations, volunteers, and civic partners.
about.scopeBody: Tailored initially for the municipalities of Constantine (Constantine Center, El Khroub, Ali Mendjeli, Ain Smara, Hamma Bouziane, Didouche Mourad, Zighoud Youcef) while architected to scale across all 58 Algerian wilayas.
about.gov1: Strict separation between domain business logic and UI presentation components.
about.gov2: Row-Level Security (PostgreSQL RLS) enforced across every table and role.
about.gov3: Zero unverified impact claims: metrics require explicit audit sign-off.
